During a '''skirmish''', the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] group the [[Aurodium Sword/Legends|Aurodium Sword]] defended their client, a [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Unidentified Sullustan executive|executive]], from a squad of industrial [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]]. Three of the Aurodium Sword members who participated in the firefight were the rogue [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|ARC trooper]] [[Muzzle/Legends|Muzzle]], the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Snoova]], and [[Unidentified Wookiee mercenary|another Wookiee]]. An [[Unidentified Imperial intelligence agent|Imperial intelligence agent]] obtained an image of the skirmish and sent it along with a report on Aurodium Sword to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Imperial [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Maximillian Seerdon]] of the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] placed both the report and image in a dossier on underworld figures he compiled in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].<ref name="UAGoSaV" />
